name: notes-frame
description: An example UI-only plugin built with the SDK (@harness/plugin-ui/sdk, loaded as harness://app/sdk/plugin-ui.js): a notes page in a sandboxed frame that lists your conversations, keeps notes in its own storage, sets a sidebar badge, and shows what happens when it calls something it was not granted. Also a settings section, a composer chip, a slash command, a prompt and a status item, all declarative.
